evidence.title: Rune Icons: open-source icons in five styles

name: Rune Icons
summary: Open-source icon library: 900+ icons in five styles, editable in the browser and copied as SVG or JSX.
description: Rune Icons draws 217 glyphs in five styles - outline, duotone, fill, pixelated and glass - for 904 SVG files once variants are counted, organised into 16 categories (action, commerce, communication, dev, layout ...). Icons can be reshaped and tuned in the browser editor (stroke, size, colour, gradient, animation), then copied as optimised SVG or JSX; npm packages exist for React, Vue, Svelte, Astro and React Native, and 1,125 brand logos ship as separate SVG files.
contains: 217 glyphs / 904 files across five styles: outline, duotone, fill, pixelated, glass
per-style counts: normal 217, duotone 213, fill 124, pixelated 215, glass 135
16 categories incl. accessibility, action, commerce, communication, dev, navigation, weather
browser editor: reshape paths, tune stroke, size, colour, gradient and animation
copy as optimised SVG or JSX; download .svg files
1,125 brand logos as SVG with license and brand-guideline links
icons Apache-2.0 with no attribution required; brand logos excluded
